title: Program Fee Billing Rules — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
## Billing rules

(a) Program fees of the Paystride Payroll Card Program are debited from the funding balance under the package held on the day they are incurred.

(b) A source entry incurs at most one fee of each fee type, and a monthly fee is debited once per billing month.

(c) On the package's monthly fee debit business day of each month the previous month is billed: the monthly program fee for every month the program was live or suspended on any day, never prorated, and the active card fee multiplied by the number of distinct card accounts opened under the program with at least one payroll load posted in the month, an active card being one with at least one payroll load posted in the month.

(d) A kit order is charged the package's kit fee for each kit beyond the kits supplied without fee (the package's kits without kit fee on the launch order, and the kits supplied under the program's Earned Wage Access bundle terms), plus the package's standard shipping fee, or the expedited shipping fee instead when shipped expedited.

(e) An off-cycle batch is charged the package's off-cycle fee when its position in the month exceeds the package's off-cycle batches without fee; its position is its place, in posting order, among the off-cycle batches of the calendar month of the batch, the batch itself included. A batch whose position is at or below the allowance carries no off-cycle fee.

(f) *No longer in force:* "A late batch, a returned funding payment, a corrected load file, a load reversal request, a reinstatement (at the package's reinstatement fee) and an early termination (at the package's early termination fee, when the program terminates before the package's minimum term from signing) are each charged once, pointing to the entry or request that incurred them." This clause is no longer in force as written; it is superseded by the current basis, under which a late batch, a returned funding payment, a corrected load file and a load reversal request are still each charged once, pointing to the entry or request that incurred them, and a reinstatement and an early termination are charged as their own current charges set.

(g) A fee that comes to zero is not debited.

## Evidence for rule (b)

A second fee of the same fee type pointing to the same source entry is not debited; for monthly fees the billing month distinguishes one month's fee from the next. Both are read from the program's funding history.

## Hypothetical billing month

A hypothetical Select package program, live throughout a month in which 212 distinct card accounts received a payroll load and two off-cycle batches posted, is billed for that month the monthly program fee of 99.00 and an active card fee of 0.25 for each of the 212 cards, 53.00. The first off-cycle batch sits at position 1, within the Select allowance of 1, and carries no off-cycle fee; the second sits at position 2 and carries the Select off-cycle fee of 3.00.

superseded_clauses: A late batch, a returned funding payment, a corrected load file, a load reversal request, a reinstatement (reinstatement_fee_usd) and an early termination (early_termination_fee_usd, when the program terminates before minimum_term_months from signing) are each charged once, pointing to the entry or request that incurred them.
